scope: Actual Engine authority-stage execution in the original Game, with independent legacy equivalence, complete CPU regression gates, preserved live saved world, and both native entry points.

requirements.requirement: Replace original Game authority stage execution with Engine
requirements.evidence: The actual createAuthorityKernel uses EngineKernel through a host-context adapter; live /api/health confirms six modules and an executed compiled Engine program after the managed server update.

requirements.requirement: Preserve stage cadence, ordering, game effects and safe large ticks
requirements.evidence: Independent frozen original kernel compared across four tiers, six publication rates and rare periods; owned mutable host state, nested calls, exceptions and late registration. Full Game gate: 1522 pass / 7 optional PostgreSQL skips. Full Engine gate: 672 pass / 19 explicitly logged skips.

requirements.requirement: Keep the existing Office as another entry into the same full Game
requirements.evidence: Four real installed Office views in the original Game, then the actual Office UI; identical account body across entries, movement/ACK, seven executed car commands, saved NPC observation/possession/movement/return, no Office physics and zero reported GPU errors.

requirements.requirement: Account-owned businesses, leases and external workforce harness survive body changes
requirements.evidence: Current account-control.test.ts/company-api.test.ts test nonempty business ownership after possession; workforce-harness.test.ts tests account keys, ownership/restart, physical work/water/rest/food and takeover fencing. All pass in the full Game run. Old protected live records and company ledger are unchanged. The fresh native browser account itself has no business/lease, so that run is not a nonempty ownership proof.

requirements.requirement: Preserve the existing saved world during the authority replacement
requirements.evidence: Consistent SQLite snapshot before managed restart; final old-row comparison has zero missing records, zero changed protected records, all old company ledger entries unchanged, integrity ok, same seed/revision and editor geometry.

requirements.requirement: Use Engine for remaining generic runtime facilities and preserve every original feature
requirements.evidence: GameWorldRuntime still instantiates old InterestPlanner, LocationScheduler and LocationSimulationPool. Their reusable mechanisms versus game-domain policy, and remaining network/audio boundaries, need further implementation/audit. A stage-kernel replacement and the selected native scenarios cannot prove the entire objective.

limits: This is a stage-execution migration, not completion of every reusable subsystem or original feature. Generic location/interest/worker boundaries remain open.
Native fresh-account rights are empty: nonempty company/lease and harness ownership relies on the current full regression suite and earlier dedicated live business proof.
FPS is an independent stationary 900-frame sample after 180 warmup frames at 704x396 internal resolution. It is not a paired regression test, sustained-60, moving/vehicle or Office UI benchmark.

No microphone/voice transport claim. Existing voice process was preserved; hub 8765 remains off. Native diagnostics retain browser autoplay/powerPreference warnings and Vite debug/events/favicon 404s; GPU error arrays are empty.
The small six-stage kernel microbenchmark is not full authority tick time or FPS.
